description: Feature flags for SafeFlow. Toggle features without code changes.

xero_auto_invoice.description: Automatically create Xero invoices for completed maintenance work
xero_auto_invoice.notes: Enable after Xero integration is fully tested and account codes verified

multilingual_support.description: Enable non-English message handling (te reo Māori, Chinese, Hindi)
multilingual_support.notes: Requires translated WhatsApp templates to be approved by Meta

photo_analysis.description: Use Claude vision to analyze maintenance photos
photo_analysis.notes: Requires claude-sonnet model with vision capability

tenant_self_registration.description: Allow unknown numbers to self-register as tenants
tenant_self_registration.notes: When false, unknown numbers receive a 'contact your property manager' message

contractor_whatsapp.description: Send job assignments to contractors via WhatsApp (vs email only)
contractor_whatsapp.notes: Requires contractor phone numbers and WhatsApp template approval

satisfaction_survey.description: Send satisfaction survey after maintenance request is resolved
satisfaction_survey.notes: Sends interactive button message asking for 1-5 rating

auto_contractor_assignment.description: Automatically assign contractors based on category and availability
auto_contractor_assignment.notes: Uses contractor specialties and availability from Contractors table

conversation_summary.description: Generate rolling conversation summaries for long conversations
conversation_summary.notes: Uses Claude to summarize conversation history beyond context window
